terms.comment: Plural pōma terrestria, potatoes. Traupman’s pulticula ex pōmīs terrestribus is mashed potatoes (ūsus: Culīna). The potato, the eggplant and the sweet pepper are modern crops wearing borrowed names.

evidence: M-O s.v. root: potato, after Perugini
terms.comment: From Spanish patata; Morgan–Owens also gives batāta, the older botanical spelling.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, printed pp. 71–72.
Theodōrus et pater: Epp. VI–VII and Culīna Theodōrī.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. root: potato.
